Excellent transport connections are available via the Central Line at Wanstead, Snaresbrook and South Woodford, alongside numerous bus routes and convenient access to the M11, M25 and North Circular Road. The generous lounge and dining area is a particular highlight, featuring an attractive bay window that allows natural light to fill the room. An elegant archway leads through to the kitchen, creating a natural transition between the two spaces while maintaining a sense of openness.
